questions.question: The pattern analysis surfaced reusable conventions from this task. Which should I capture as documented coding patterns (handed to task-add-coding-pattern-or-design)?

options.label: timer-effect-with-cleanup (rec.)
options.description: useEffect keyed on a boolean trigger that early-returns when off, sets a setTimeout/setInterval, and returns cleanup that BOTH clears the timer AND resets the derived state. Now appears twice (use-google-auth.ts + use-elapsed-timer.ts). Recommended — a separate coding-patterns/ file.

options.label: additive-ui-gated-by-hook-flag
options.description: Render secondary/reassurance UI as a separate {flag && <…/>} block driven by a dedicated hook flag, layered alongside the existing element rather than branching it. Single occurrence so far; close to generic conditional rendering. I lean against it.

options.label: Capture none
options.description: Don't document any new convention from this task — the existing registries already cover the meaningful choices (named constants, boolean naming, hook/destructure patterns).
